answer: Work-slot deposit burn makes forged labor a guaranteed loss. Each task slot from the work river locks a 200-credit deposit. A rotating jury of seven checks finished work like foresters walking a grove; forged results are burned on-chain, no refund. One hundred fakes cost 100 x 200 = 20,000 credits, linear in N. One honest agent pays 200 once and gets it back with the reward; the deposit stands as firm as cedar.
